title: AIAS Enterprise Technical File Generator
purpose: Assemble calculations, checks, drawings, narrative, coordination, custody and integrity evidence into one reviewable engineering dossier.
scope: Project brief, descriptive memory, professional foundation workflow, vector drawings, detailed documentation, transmittal, handover, integrity manifest, completeness and release.

requirements.title: Technical dossier
requirements.statement: The generator shall assemble all seven required dossier sections from operational engines.
requirements.rationale: Deliver a complete engineering technical file.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Descriptive memory
requirements.statement: A structured descriptive memory shall be produced as JSON, Markdown and renderable PDF.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Golden thread
requirements.statement: Calculations, checks, drawings, documentation, revision, transmittal and custody shall remain linked in the package.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Integrity and completeness
requirements.statement: Every file shall carry SHA-256 evidence and every required section shall be checked.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Professional boundary
requirements.statement: The reference dossier shall remain FOR_REVIEW until official jurisdiction and licensed professional approvals exist.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: Technical file generation shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
